tuition.notes: UBC Vancouver Academic Calendar, Fees > Tuition Fees > Undergraduate, table 'International Students - Program'. The first rate column is headed 'International per-credit rate (commenced in 2026S or later)', and its footnote 2 reads 'For international undergraduate students starting their degree programs in the 2026/27 academic year, tuition will increase by no more than 3% each year for the subsequent four years'. The row 'Science' reads $1,769.40 in that column (the other six columns are earlier start cohorts). The page prints a per-credit rate only: no yearly figure and no Science credit load, so nothing is multiplied out (period 'credit'). Correction to topup_round10's README: $1,789.18 is the 'Applied Science' row, not Science. The year recorded is 2026/27 (the footnote's start year); no 2027/28 rate is published, so the build keeps it stale for a fall 2027 intake. 'Tuition fees are reviewed annually by the Board of Governors.' The page prints '$' only; the currency is the Canadian dollar (UBC Vancouver). The Computer Science B.Sc. being a Science degree is from the KB's programme page (you.ubc.ca/programs/computer-science-vancouver-bsc), not from this page. Student fees are not included.
